aarti.pad1: Father, mother, helper, master and friend:
you alone are our one Lord.
Those who have no other support,
aarti.pad2: You always give happiness in every way;
you are the destroyer of sorrow and vice.
holding exceeding compassion in your heart.
aarti.pad3: but you do not let us slip from your mind.
There is no end to your kindnesses,
which you spread out moment by moment.
aarti.pad4: Your glory is great, O Mahārāja;
rarely found by the likes of me, you belong to the wise.
You are the home of blessed peace, a treasure-house of love,
the light in the temple of the mind.
aarti.pad5: You are the life of this life,
the beloved of these breaths of life.
Having found a Lord like you, O Hari,
on whom else should Pratāpa now depend?
